can be used to set the namespace from which an external controller or operator creates Routes that route traffic to Camunda services. can be used to set the namespace where the Gateway that the Routes point to lives. opt-in automatic pod rollout on CA rotation. When true, the chart stamps a checksum/ca-bundle pod annotation derived from the CA Secret so the next `helm upgrade` rolls the Java components when the CA changes. OFF by default: it uses Helm's `lookup` to read the Secret at upgrade time, which (a) REQUIRES the upgrading identity to have `get` on Secrets in the release namespace — without it, `helm upgrade` fails to render — and (b) is inert under GitOps tools that render with `helm template` (no cluster access). When off (or in those cases), rotate the CA with `kubectl rollout restart` (see the TLS guide). Trust itself never depends on this flag.

OPTIONAL override for the truststore init-container image. Empty (default) reuses each component's OWN image: it already ships keytool, it is already mirrored in your registry (so this adds no new image dependency in air-gapped installs), and copying its cacerts preserves any CAs baked into a custom build. Set this only if a component image lacks keytool — the value is used verbatim (NOT prefixed with global.image.registry), so include your registry/mirror path if needed.
